verdict.rationale: Latency and turn-taking are a fair axis for a voice AI platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents end-to-end latency numbers, benchmarks, or tuning guidance. The pack covers pathways, webhooks, evals, testbed, SIP, canary deployments, MCP and CLI; none of these address speed claims.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims
